fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-05-17 (evening, 19:15): The complainant was allegedly assaulted during an argument near Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore, resulting in minor injuries. The complaint was lodged by Arun Prakash (9000000194). A second person, Elango Prakash (9000000351), was also mentioned as possibly present. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant alleged that Senthil Krishnan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000461. The complainant mentioned photographs, physical documents and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Dispute reportedly escalated into a physical altercation.
